environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443. TLS termination at the instance via nginx reverse proxy to localhost:8080. No application-layer filtering. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. SQLite database on local EBS volume. Python 3.11, Flask 3.0.0, gunicorn 21.2.0 with 4 workers.
